issues.on_page: Motor vehicle taxes 1,962,358 = General 1,954,493 + Special Building 7,865
issues.issue: The statement prints Special Building's 7,865 on the Motor vehicle taxes row, but the Special Building budget schedule (p21) shows 7,865 as 'Interest and penalty on property taxes'. So the statement's motor vehicle line looks overstated by 7,865 and the interest/penalties line (43,496) understated by the same amount. The figure is recorded as printed, which is correct, but this is not mentioned in notes or report_discrepancies, and the detail records the 7,865 as property tax.

issues.on_page: Reclassifications: State programs (207,894), Federal programs (773,020), Instruction +415,914
issues.issue: The State/Federal programs contra line uses the net 565,000 (980,914 reclassified out less 415,914 moved into Instruction). That works because the extractor put those program lines under instruction, but it is an assumption about which lines held the hidden 1,040,000 transfer. The page only shows group-level reclassifications. Arithmetic checks: 80,000 + 145,000 + 250,000 + 565,000 = 1,040,000, which matches the Depreciation Fund transfer received on p17.
